name: Histogram Equalization
description: Global histogram equalization of the luma of each frame, mixed with the original by a strength.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Picture to equalize, at least 256 pixels wide

params.name: strength
params.description: Mix of the equalized and the original luma: 0 leaves the picture, 1 equalizes fully

params.name: intensity
params.description: Largest output luma of the equalization, as a fraction of 1000/255 (0.255 maps to full white)

params.name: antibanding
params.description: Random dither of the output luma between neighbouring table entries, against banding
